name: nexora-monorepo
description: Nexora Single-Vendor Hardware E-Commerce & Store Management Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nexora/config && npm run build -w @nexora/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nexora/api && npm run build -w @nexora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @nexora/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexora/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run packages/shared/tests apps/web/tests apps/api/tests/app.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration -w @nexora/api
